_comment: Legacy URLs Bing Webmaster still held as 404 on 25 Sep 2026 (Site Explorer, virtualagency-os.com). None is linked from a live page or listed in the sitemap.

scripts/update_redirects_clean_to_html.js emits each entry into _redirects as a 301. scripts/validators/validate_redirect_targets.js fails the build if a target is not a page this build publishes, if a target itself redirects (a chain), or if an entry is missing from _redirects.
Every entry lands on a live page on the same topic. A URL with no same-topic page stays a 404 and is not listed here; nothing is sent to the homepage.
